description: Search open artificial intelligence and machine learning jobs, and AI training work (AI trainers, evaluators, annotators), at companies worldwide. Returns the newest matches first, or the best matches for the query. Each job's url is its Neural Roles page, with the full description and the link to apply.

experience_level.description: intern, entry, mid, senior, staff, principal, manager, director

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. ES, US. Remote jobs open to it count.

query.description: Natural language search query, e.g. 'machine learning engineer', 'LLM', 'AI trainer spanish'. May be empty.

name: search_jobs
title: Search AI jobs
